citeAs: Lin Chen, Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Zehui Chen, Haodong Duan, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao (2024). Are We on the Right Way for Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models?. arXiv preprint arXiv:2403.20330v2.
creator: Lin Chen, Jinsong Li, Xiaoyi Dong, Pan Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Zehui Chen, Haodong Duan, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao, Dahua Lin, Feng Zhao (University of Science and Technology of China, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory)
description: An elite vision-indispensable multi-modal benchmark comprising 1,500 samples meticulously selected by humans to evaluate LVLMs' multi-modal capacities with carefully balanced and purified samples.
name: MMStar
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three experts conduct manual review to ensure visual dependency, comprehensive range of capability assessment dimensions, and advanced multi-modal abilities required.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is designed to mitigate data leakage and visual-unnecessary biases present in existing benchmarks.
rai:dataCollection: Samples are first roughly selected from current benchmarks with an automated pipeline using eight LLMs as inspectors. Samples answered by more than 2 of 8 LLMs are excluded. Then 16 LVLMs gauge difficulty. Finally, strict manual review and selection are applied to curate 1,500 high-quality multimodal evaluation samples.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Samples from existing multi-modal benchmarks including MMBench, SEED, MMMU, ScienceQA, AI2D, and MathVista.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: In the future, we plan to expand MMStar into a larger, online test set and explore dynamic evaluation methods.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the actual multi-modal capacities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs).
rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT4-Turbo, GeminiPro, LLaMA-70B, Qwen-1.5-72B, Mixtral-8x7B, etc. used as inspectors for visual dependency and LLM leakage.

null_reasons.rai:dataLimitations: Not explicitly discussed as limitations of MMStar itself
